reports.SiteNumber: skip: internal site registration number, an identifier; SiteName carries the same grouping
reports.SiteName: chart-sites, chart-downtime, chart-chimneys, table-recent, kpi:sites, kpi:top_share, insight:concentration — test-portal rows detected by region/name are excluded and disclosed
reports.SiteRegion: chart-regions — also flags the ministry's test district rows
reports.SiteAddress: skip: one address per site (redundant with SiteName); the explorer shows it
reports.ReportActualDate: chart-lag, table-recent, kpi:lag, insight:lag — report date vs fault start
reports.ChimneyName: chart-chimneys, table-recent, chart-sites — distinct chimneys per site in the sites table
reports.PollutingName: chart-pollutants, table-recent — names normalized by the abbreviation in parentheses
reports.StartDate: chart-timeline, chart-duration, chart-lag, insight:trend, insight:duration, kpi:span
reports.FaultTypeDesc: chart-themes, table-recent, insight:theme — keyword themes; shown as the fault label in recent reports
reports.Remarks: chart-themes, chart-downtime, insight:downtime, insight:theme — free text never quoted; keyword themes and stated downtime hours only
